description:
Flameco group delivers sustainable building materials and architectural solutions. With 25+ years of experience, we partner with global brands to offer eco-friendly products like wall printing, liquid floors, lighting, and more for your construction projects.

The Flameco group ChatGPT App gives users access to general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to discover Flameco group's product offerings, submit queries to the Flameco group team and book meetings.
